title: Contrastive Graph Representations for Automated Hypothesis Generation
summary: Automated hypothesis synthesis often fails due to shallow keyword associations. We propose a self-supervised contrastive graph representation model that maps disparate academic domains into a shared metric manifold. Evaluating 12,000 interdisciplinary pairs, our model achieves an MRR of 0.781 on 0-hop frontier link prediction, discovering 3.4x more validated cross-domain hypotheses than vanilla sentence embeddings.
